title: StitchVector 3.0 geometry-first metrics G1-G3: evaluation plan, pushed and remote-verified before any existing output is scored
nature: retrospective scoring of EXISTING outputs; no new generation, no algorithm or parameter change; not a blind test

inputs.synthetic: runs/stitchvector/v3_linefaces/gpkg/synth_{7001..7005}_{F0,B0,B2c}.gpkg and scene_{7101..7105}_{kind}_{F0,B0,B2c}.gpkg (line+face POC test outputs, 419cf71); SHA-256 checked against experiments/STITCHVECTOR/lf/linefaces_test_artifacts_sha256.txt before scoring
inputs.u2: runs/stitchvector/v3_u2_real/gpkg/u2_{F0,B0,B2c}.gpkg (fcf7e5e; SHA-256 checked against u2real/u2_artifacts_sha256.txt) and the Oracle v2 reference runs/stitchvector/oracle_u2_300_v2/O1_class_tol0.gpkg (sha256 c499d548...)
inputs.truth: synthetic: sv_synth.generate / sv_b2c_scenes.scene with the same seeds (deterministic, frozen generators). u2: Oracle traces (selected lines only, no text, no symbols) and the protected bands PN1 / PN2. Truth is used only for scoring.

truth_elements.ink_line: axis of every drawn ink line; visible samples = not under a later-drawn ink line (half width + 0.5 px)
truth_elements.fill_boundary: synthetic tiles: exterior of each fill polygon minus the interiors of later-drawn fills, clipped to the tile; scenes: the drawn fill edges that are not covered by ink. Visible = not under ink and not under a band. u2: none (no truth)
truth_elements.band: axis + width of each fill-coloured band (synthetic) or Oracle protected band (u2, width = 2 x radius); visible = not under ink

matching.rule: a truth sample (1 px) is matched by an output kind if a sample of that kind (every 0.5 px) lies within tol and its tangent is within 30 deg (either orientation); matches count as reusable only inside runs of >= 5 consecutive matched visible samples. Face boundaries along the tile frame are ignored.

ink_line: face_outline (only polygon edges along the ink: geometry exists, conversion needed)
needs_fix (some geometry within half width + 1.5 px, not reusable)
fill_boundary: line_only (only a line along it: split the face along the line)
band_axis: face_ok (both sides matched by face edges AND a band-dedicated face at the axis)
line_convert (reusable centreline: re-widen + line-to-face + difference with the face below)

G1.G1a_geometry_present: share of visible truth samples NOT 'missing'
G1.G1c_convertible: share that is face_outline / line_only / line_convert (geometry usable after a conversion, reported apart from G1b)

G2.note: all lengths are truth-axis samples; areas are never converted to lengths

ops: redraw: runs of >= 3 consecutive missing samples (one manual trace each)
split_face_along_line: runs of line_only on fill boundaries
line_to_face: bands with any line_convert run (each also needs rewidth)
convert_outline_to_line: ink lines with face_outline runs

recolour_line / rewidth_line: logical groups owning an ink line (>= 60% of length within 2 px) whose colour differs > 15 dE from the original along the line or whose width differs > 1 px from truth (synthetic only)
delete_false_line: groups owning no ink and no band
split_cross_line: groups running >= 10 px along two ink lines outside their shared zone

face recolour: faces (not ink faces) whose colour differs > 15 dE from their majority truth colour, counted individually and as a safe-batch lower bound (a colour can be batch-changed only if all its faces belong to one truth colour)
face merge: per truth region, faces assigned - 1
face split: faces whose second truth region holds >= 10% and >= 20 px
G3.proxy_cost: illustrative only, not user time: 1 per click-level op (recolour, rewidth, delete, split, line_to_face counted 3), 1 per merged face, 1 per 10 px of redraw or adjust length, 1 per convert_outline_to_line counted as redraw of its length ; each line_to_face op is costed 4 (3 for buffer + difference + merge, 1 for the width change it needs)

u2_band_repair: per band and line method: centreline coverage (tolerance only, and with direction + runs), gap runs; widened-line core coverage = area(band core ∩ union(in-band line parts buffered to band radius)); union with band faces; widened area outside the band; length of the same logical groups outside the band (what a whole-group edit would also change). Replaces the invalid redraw_axis_length_estimate_px of sv_gc_repairability (area + area summed and converted to a length)
stop_rule: one scoring run; no change to definitions after the first number
pre_freeze_smoke: scorer run on freshly built dev outputs (synthetic 1201, scenes 1301; not the test outputs) to check it runs; one bug fixed before freeze: the per-band boolean 'line_convert' flag overwrote the line_convert sample count. No definition changed.
